verdict.rationale: Microsoft's own docs explicitly state OneDrive enables real-time coauthoring in Word, Excel, and PowerPoint, directly matching the story of in-place co-editing in the browser/native apps. Community evidence discusses sync/backup pain points but does not concretely contradict co-authoring functionality itself. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of real-time co-editing quality/reliability specifically (vs. general sync complaints), and more detail on browser-based editing UX.
